anomalies.observed: On the Power sheet, the INA219AIDCNR (U1) SCL (pin 5) and SDA (pin 6) are tied to I2C2_SCL_FCC / I2C2_SDA_FCC with its address note 'I2C address: 0x40'. On the FCC Peripherals sheet, the PCA9685PW (U2) SCL (pin 26) and SDA (pin 27) are tied to the same nets I2C2_SCL_FCC / I2C2_SDA_FCC, also with 'I2C address: 0x40' (all A0–A5 straps shown to GND). Meanwhile I2C3_SCL_FCC / I2C3_SDA_FCC have their own pull-ups (R13, R14) on the FCC sheet but no peripheral attached.
anomalies.expected: Two devices that share the same I2C address (0x40) must not sit on the same bus; the spec lists both the INA219 and the PCA9685 at I2C addr 0x40, so they were intended to live on separate buses (e.g. the PCA9685 on the otherwise-empty I2C3_FCC) or be configured to distinct addresses.

anomalies.impact: Both the power/telemetry sensor and the 16-channel servo driver answer to address 0x40 on the same I2C2_FCC bus, so the FCC cannot address them independently; transactions intended for one device will be acknowledged by both, corrupting current/voltage readings and servo/PWM control.
